Worst dining experience ever
Feb 2019 • Friends
I booked this restaurant through my wedding planner for a dinner for 40 people. Everything was pre organised before the event, location is stunning but unfortunately that is the only good thing about it. With 40 plus staff working and about 20 other people in the restaurant, it took them 2 hrs to take our orders, taking 3 orders at a time. When the food came out it was incorrect, missing food and 30% of our guests didn’t even get to eat! Throughout the night our guests were paying for drinks and when the bill came to over 17 million dong we were shocked. They doubled dipped and charged us for all the drinks we paid for and even though our most expensive meal was 450,000 dong, per person we ended up paying almost 800,000 per person.
The staff were rude and ignored us and walked away with any request; we ended up clearing our own tables because they wouldn’t remove any empty drinks or plates. The staff were more interested in their own dinner, to which they were sitting one table away during our meal. Don’t waste your time going here, will never recommend to any friends or family.

Feel cheated, bad service, food not good
Aug 2016 • Couples
We arrived and has to call people to serve us, even though hardly anyone there, service is very slow. We got our own menus from the front as we are waiting so long, that was a problem in the end. They have almost no vegetarian options at all, except for egg dish and noodles, so I ordered noodles and my lady for the egg. The egg is a small omelette with greens, and my noodles was a large portion of what appeared to be instant 2min noodles with boiled onions and bak Choi and baby corn. It was tasteless but at least there was chilli sauce to give it some flavour. The noodles on the menu are advertised as 40 or 45 000 Dong, and when the bill came, it was 120 000 Dong! I specifically asked for those noodles because it was cheap, and there are NO other vegetarian noodles. I asked why the price so high and they said the cheap price is breakfast menu, the lunch menu is 120 000. I went and got the lunch menu to verify, and the noodles are 120 000, but there are NO vegetarian noodles on lunch menu. ONLY beef, chicken, seafood noodles on lunch menu. They refused to let me pay the price for the noodles they let me order, which is vegetarian noodles, on the breakfast menu. I had to pay lunch menu noodle price for meat noodles I did not order. If I had known it would be 3 times the price, I would have ordered the egg. They took my order and said nothing, then cheat you with the bill. The second thing is the bill also had a mystery amount on it! Asked what that was for, and was told it was for the napkins!? They charged us for the napkins! They did not tell is they would be doing this either! A nice day was fined by bad service, bad food, and being cheated by them. The English is fine until you want to dispute the bill, then the only English is 'you pay now!'. They did not understand calling the owner, manager, someone in charge. We spoke to 3 people who worked there who all insisted we pay. Extremely bad customer service, eventually we paid and left otherwise things would have gotten ugly and messy, clearly they do not even attempt to understand what they did wrong.
